_README: Per-name thesis horizon in YEARS (lesson L1, 2026-07-02 —
The Step-12 trade-gate clamp table was written for the ~12-18-month
clock of the memory-cycle trade (default 1.25y). A name whose thesis
plays out on a longer clock (robotics-class: 3y+) gets its clamp
thresholds scaled to annualized-return equivalence: t^(h/1.25).
Tickers not listed use the default 1.25y — behavior identical to the
pre-L1 gate. Valid range 0.25-10.0; out-of-bounds values fall back to
the default and are flagged in the verdict's enforcement record.
